summary: Prepare evidence-backed application reviews and a separate human review set without automatically rejecting, advancing, ranking, or changing applicant records.

useCases.title: Review an application backlog
useCases.message: Review these applications against our accepted criteria, show the evidence and unknowns, and prepare a separate set for human review.

useCases.title: Review applicants for a key role
useCases.message: Help me review these applicants consistently without making or executing the hiring decision.
